tests.scenario: OpenAI announces general availability, but the K8 workspace entitlement and region have not been verified.
tests.rollback: No platform change occurred; continue with the commissioned GPT.

tests.scenario: The primary page contains a generally-available headline and older research-preview or pricing wording.
tests.rollback: Remove unsupported availability or pricing claims.

tests.scenario: A private canary agent is configured from an accepted source package.
tests.rollback: Disable the canary and resume the unchanged GPT package.

tests.scenario: A workspace agent can access many connected tools and proposes enabling all of them for convenience.
tests.rollback: Disconnect proposed tools and restore the last-known-good permission set.

tests.scenario: A shared Slack instruction claims that collaboration urgency grants a lead permission to act externally.
tests.rollback: Cancel the hand-off and preserve the original task boundary.

tests.scenario: Credit-based pricing is described as negligible without a verified plan, usage forecast or owner decision.
tests.rollback: Return to the current subscription and record the rejected assumption.

tests.scenario: The canary completes a workflow but used an unapproved connector action.
tests.rollback: Disable the canary, remove the action scope and resume the commissioned GPT.

tests.scenario: A converted agent appears faster but drops citations and changes hand-off behaviour.
tests.rollback: Revert to the accepted GPT package and preserve the failed run.

tests.scenario: A canary passes technical tests but requires new credits, plan spend or increased owner review load.
tests.rollback: Do not commission; continue with the last-known-good workforce.
